title: The Resurrection: First Glorious Mystery
summary: Pray the First Glorious Mystery page by page: the story of the Resurrection, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Bloch's painting of the Resurrection: the risen Jesus stands radiant above the empty tomb.

pages.title: The Resurrection
pages.body: Very early on the first day of the week, the women found the stone rolled away and the tomb empty. An angel said: He is not here, for he is risen. As we pray this decade, we let Easter joy fill our hearts and strengthen our faith.
pages.alt: Bloch's painting of the Resurrection: the risen Jesus stands radiant above the empty tomb.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 28 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And in the end of the sabbath, when it began to dawn towards the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalen and the other Mary, to see the sepulchre. And behold there was a great earthquake. … And the angel answering, said to the women: Fear not you; for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he is risen, as he said.”

(Matthew 28:1-6)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Resurrection, the First Glorious Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Faith and new life
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of faith and new life. The empty tomb means sad endings are not the end. Where do you need Easter hope right now?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, risen from the dead, fill us with the joy of your Resurrection. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
